captions.detailed: A wall-mounted task lamp consisting of a vertical rectangular backplate, a two-segment folding arm, and a bell-shaped light shade. The backplate, joints, and thin cylindrical arm segments are finished in matte black, while the hollow, conical lamp shade is a contrasting off-white. The arm segments connect via compact, square-profile hinge blocks, allowing articulation, and the lamp shade rotates at the tip of the second arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a wall-mounted task lamp. It must feature a rectangular wall bracket, a two-part articulated arm made of thin cylindrical rods connected by blocky hinge joints, and a conical, hollowed-out off-white lamp shade at the end that can rotate.
captions.factory: The code constructs the lamp using an ArticulatedObject framework. It starts with a base wall bracket made from a thin rectangular box. Two arm segments are modeled using thin cylinders for the rods, joined by square boxes that form the pivot hinges. The lamp head is constructed by lofting or combining concentric cylinders/cones to form a hollowed-out bell shade. Revolute articulations are defined at each joint connection to allow folding of the arms and rotation of the shade.
